database_open_failed.title: Couldn't open the database
database_open_failed.body: Your data is safe — the database files on disk were not modified or deleted. {{appName}} couldn't open its local database this launch, so your history may not appear. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, reinstall or repair {{appName}}. Avoid creating new chats until it's resolved, to keep your data consistent.

context_window_exceeded.title: Conversation history exceeded model context
context_window_exceeded.body: The accumulated conversation has exceeded the model's context window. Compact history to continue, or start a new conversation.

single_request_too_large.title: This input is too large
single_request_too_large.body: The content you sent ({{bytes}}) exceeds the current model's per-request size limit. Please shrink images, split files, or reduce the input and retry. Previous conversation history is preserved.

request_body_too_large.title: Request body too large to send
request_body_too_large.body: The request body ({{bytes}}) exceeds the transport size limit and was not sent. Please shrink images or remove attachments and retry.

quota.title: Insufficient credit balance
quota.body: Your credit balance is exhausted. Please top up to continue.

rate_limit.title: Rate limited
rate_limit.body: Too many requests; please try again shortly.

auth.title: Authentication failed
auth.body: Please check your API key configuration.

network.title: Network error
network.body: Connection failed; please check your network and retry.

timeout.title: Request timed out
timeout.body: The request timed out; please retry shortly.
